Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the "Analysis of Previous Result" section of its first turn. It incorrectly interpreted the search results displayed by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer showed a DuckDuckGo search results page where the snippet for EBSCO clearly stated "Place of death: Weimar". However, the Planner hallucinated that the results indicated "Frankfurt am Main" as the place of death. This misreading of the visible text led to the generation of a completely false final answer.
